status: Performance-qualified representative scalar DISTINCT first/last increment; existing single-phase and TTL gates remain. All final representative medians beat paired stock; prior controls retained from identical earlier fixtures. This does not establish a universal workload speedup.
measurement: Identical queries/data/resources in each interleaved engine comparison, two warmups/five repeats. Runtime row source, both transposes, production JNI/IPC/state, rowwise blackhole sink and native plan/consumption assertions retained. No concurrent local builds/tests/profiles/timings. Existing prior controls have the same fixture hash, resources and queries; their dates/ranges remain explicit rather than presenting them as newly rerun controls.

validation.details: Typed scalar SQL/filter/retract/recreation checks, raw floating payloads and signed zeros, pure/COUNT-DISTINCT/COUNT-star contexts, two memory/RocksDB restores, shared DATE/TIME COUNT-DISTINCT partial views and journals. Thirty-two native mixed fixtures independently predict every pre/postimage.

historical_losses: Retained all initial type losses, mixed COUNT regressions, small-size timestamp loss versus prior, CPU diagnosis and subsequent DATE confirmation losses. Profiled timings are diagnostic and excluded from speed claims.
allocation_note: Allocation requests and requested/Arrow buffer bytes are not copied-byte measurements.
